India U20 Men's Football Squad Named for Singapore Friendlies

Head coach Mahesh Gawali has announced the India U20 men's football squad for two upcoming friendly matches against Singapore. The squad selection is for preparatory games ahead of future tournaments. The specific dates and venues for the friendlies were not detailed in the coverage.
